When the buffer is full, it calls `bo.write(out_buffer, 0, BUFF_SIZE)`. The `bo.write` method (from the API documentation) declares three exception types: NullPointerException (if the byte array is null), IndexOutOfBoundsException (if off or len are negative or off+len exceeds array length), and IOException (if an I/O error occurs, e.g., stream closed). However, there is no validation or error handling to prevent IOException, which can occur if the underlying stream (bo) is closed or encounters an I/O error. Therefore, only IOException is not avoided.
